policy.normal: All compared properties within 0.5%; registration and parser confirmed. Still requires project-specific code checks.
policy.review: A property differs by >0.5% and <=10%. Display a review warning; never mark the properties as identical.
policy.quarantine: Difference >10%, registration/parser failure, or no supported material. Exclude from normal selection pending review.
policy.materialSupport: Implementation range screening at 1000 mm reference lengths for each available material; not design adequacy or member/connection approval.
policy.engineeringProperties: No Gen property is substituted for the current application formulas. Cold-formed shapes retain preliminary status.
